'''Minimech CM-12''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model manufactured and available for purchase in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point before and during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Minimech CM-12 is a pet companion, added to the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] with Update 2.9.0 and available from the Architect's Stronghold Pack.

*[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] {{1st}}
